Attached are our W-9 and our partially completed onboarding form — I left the remittance fields for you to confirm which remit email and PO instructions Redwood prefers. Also attaching a copy of a voided check for ACH verification. We'll redact anything you don't want published.

- Any specific invoice fields mandatory for automated payments (e.g., Redwood supplier code, project code, PO number placement)?

I've attached: FirstMile_W9.pdf, FirstMile_Onboarding_Form.xlsx, FirstMile_Voided_Check.jpg

Hi Lena —

Thanks for sending these over and for the clear answers. Welcome aboard — we should be able to finalize the vendor record quickly if we get a couple items completed. Below is a short onboarding checklist and how we handle payments at Redwood: 

Redwood quick checklist for vendor setup
- Completed vendor onboarding form (we'll accept the spreadsheet you sent)
- Valid W-9 on file (attached: OK)
- ACH verification: voided check or bank letter (attached: OK)
- Remit email: please confirm which email you want on the invoice and for automated remittance notifications
- Invoice delivery: prefer invoices to be sent to invoices@redwood-inference.com; we also have a vendor portal for file uploads (https://vendors.redwood-inference.com/upload)
- PO policy: Redwood issues POs for all purchases >= $1,000. PO number is required on the invoice for automated processing. For < $1,000, AP can process without PO but it may take longer for payment.
- Mandatory invoice fields for automated processing: Redwood supplier ID (we'll provide once supplier record created), PO number (if applicable), invoice date, invoice number, line-item description, net amount, tax if applicable

Preferred payment methods
- ACH (ACH is our default for US banks) — preferred for cost and speed.
- Wire — available for expedited payments; finance charges may apply if wire fees are requested by the vendor.

Please attach a completed onboarding form with the remit email and whether you want net30 confirmed. Also attach a remittance contact (name/email) and your invoice sample (if you have one). I've attached our vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf and remittance_template.csv — please fill and return.

Next steps on our side (internal)
- Once we receive the completed form + confirmed remit email, I'll route supplier creation to Finance.
- Finance (Monica) will create the supplier in our AP system and return a Redwood supplier ID.
- We will confirm PO thresholds and send over an initial PO if needed.

If you prefer, we can run a quick 15-minute screen share to step through the portal and confirm invoice fields.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
